ingredients.title: For the Chicken Poach / Broth
items: 1.5 kg chicken pieces (mix of thighs and drumsticks, or any preferred cut)
1 small onion (or half a large one)

method.title: For the Chicken broth
steps: Place the chicken in a large pot and cover with cold water.
Bring to a boil and skim off the foam (scum) that rises to the surface this keeps your broth clear and golden.
Once clear, add onion, lemon peel, cardamom pods, cloves, cinnamon stick, and salt.
Reduce heat and simmer gently for 45–60 minutes, until chicken is tender and fragrant.
Remove chicken, cool slightly, and shred.
Strain the broth and reserve it for the rice. Top the shredded chicken with a little broth so you can reheat gently later before serving.

method.title: For the rice
steps: In a pot, melt ghee and cook the minced meat until golden and fragrant.
Add pistachios and sultanas, stirring until lightly toasted.
Sprinkle in all your spices and stir for 30 seconds to release their aroma.
Add the drained rice and coat it evenly with the spiced ghee mixture.
Pour in the hot chicken stock, bring to a gentle boil, then cover and reduce to low.
Simmer until the rice is cooked and the stock absorbed.

Turn off the heat and let it rest, covered, for 10 minutes before fluffing. Layer the rice evenly, pressing it down lightly with the back of a spoon to create a neat surface. Top with the shredded chicken, spreading it across the rice so every bite has a bit of everything. Finish with a generous handful of fried nuts for crunch and a final sprinkle of Lebanese 7 spice — that’s my mum’s special touch. Serve immediately alongside the chicken fatteh.
